{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify and remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
qa_orders = data[qa_mask]

# Drop QA orders
data_clean = data[~qa_mask].copy()

# Confirm QA orders are removed
print(f"Number of QA orders after removal: {len(data_clean[data_clean['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99])}")

# Also, ensure we only consider completed orders (not refunded)
completed_mask = data_clean['status'] == 'completed'
completed_data = data_clean[completed_mask]

# Confirm refunded orders are filtered out
print(f"Number of refunded orders after filtering: {len(completed_data[completed_data['status'] == 'refunded'])}")

# Now filter for LOYAL customers
loyal_mask = completed_data['customer_segment'] == 'loyal'
loyal_completed = completed_data[loyal_mask]

# Compute mean revenue for LOYAL customers in completed orders
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders from LOYAL customers: {mean_revenue}")"}
